data.name: Bivash
data.long_meaning: Bivash is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘buddhi’, which means intellect or mind. The name is dedicated to the lord of the mind, symbolizing deep wisdom and understanding. This name is believed to bestow the gift of a sharp intellect and a strong willpower on the bearer.
